tools.name: audit_fees
tools.description: Audit a list of fees: annualize each one (monthly x12), total the yearly cost and monthly average, and flag charges above the typical US range for their category, duplicate names and one-time fees of $30+ worth disputing. Use when the user lists fees to review. For a multi-year projection use annual

tools.name: annual_cost
tools.description: Project the cumulative cost of a fee list over 1-30 years by straight multiplication of each fee's annualized amount (no compounding or inflation; one-time fees are counted every year), with a per-fee breakdown. Use for 'what will these cost me over N years'. It does not flag fees: use audit_fees to

tools.name: benchmark_fees
tools.description: Look up typical US consumer fee ranges (min/max per charge, USD) for one category such as bank_overdraft, or the full 14-category table when category is omitted. Use to answer 'is this fee normal?' questions. To check a user's own list of fees against these ranges, use audit_fees.

tools.name: dispute_letter
tools.description: Draft (text only; nothing is sent) a firm, polite letter asking a company to reverse or refund one specific fee, with grounds, a 14-day written-response request, an escalation path and sending tips. Use once the user has picked a fee to contest. To find which fees are worth disputing first, use audi
